newsitem.title: TAIWAN: More Taiwan banks cut interest rates.
newsitem.headline: More Taiwan banks cut interest rates.

text.p: Two major Taiwan banks said on Thursday they would cut the banks' prime lending rates to reflect loose liquidity in the banking system, effective from Friday.
Taiwan Cooperative Bank would cut its prime rate by 0.025 percentage points to 7.275, while the Farmers Bank of China would reduce the prime rate by 0.02 percentage point to 7.68.
The Cooperative Bank would also slash its various time deposit rates by 0.10-0.15 percentage points.
First Bank, one of the island's Big Three state-run banks, would cut its various time deposit rates by 0.05-0.20 percentage points.
The rate cuts followed Bank of Taiwan's late Wednesday decision to reduce its one-to-three-year time deposits by 0.05-0.20 percentage points, effective on Thursday.
